chunks: So that when you sit astride of them and think of the bounties of your Lord, you may say: 'All glory to Him who subjugated these for us. We were incapable of doing so.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication when riding a camel or animal in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah Az-Zukhruf, establishes the ritual etiquette (adab) of riding, transforming a mundane act into an act of worship by linking physical comfort with spiritual remembrance (dhikr). Shia scholars emphasize the phrase 'subhan alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha' as a recognition of divine facilitation, highlighting human humility and the transient nature of worldly blessings. It serves as a practical reminder to maintain gratitude and awareness of God's power even in moments of ease and mobility.
